zh.summary: 完善长期存储维护、离线依赖整理与数据导入中断恢复。
highlights: 设置页可整理插件依赖缓存；保留当前环境及回滚引用，并在整理后验证离线重建。修复完整离线包默认插件导致的清理误拒绝。
回收可确认不再使用的受管 WebView 运行时，保留正在运行的浏览器及登录数据。
数据导入记录事务阶段；导入进程中断后，启动和独立恢复入口可识别并恢复未完成事务。
默认插件旧版升级、卸载重装及多客户端同时安装纳入成品验收，避免并发修改同一插件目录。
knownIssues: 物理断电和跨磁盘移动中断未作兼容承诺；跨机凭据可能需要重新登录。
多屏及不同 DPI 的完整硬件组合仍在专项跟踪。
upgradeNotes: 保持 DSH 0.1.7-alpha.1、会话管理 1.5.1 和图片查看器 0.1.2；较新内核须独立通过兼容验收后推送。
插件依赖整理是主动操作。清理无法证明安全时会保留原数据并报告原因。

en.summary: Improve long-term storage maintenance, offline dependency cleanup and interrupted data-import recovery.
highlights: Clean plugin dependency caches from settings while retaining current and rollback references and verifying offline reconstruction. Fix incorrect cleanup refusal for bundled default plugins.
Reclaim managed WebView runtimes only when they are no longer in use, retaining active browsers and sign-in data.
Journal data-import stages so startup and independent recovery can identify and recover interrupted imports.
Qualify historical default-plugin upgrades, uninstall/reinstall and concurrent clients against packaged products to protect the shared plugin profile.
knownIssues: Physical power loss and interrupted cross-volume moves are not qualified; credentials moved between machines may require signing in again.
The full multi-monitor and mixed-DPI hardware matrix remains a separate tracked qualification.
upgradeNotes: Retain DSH 0.1.7-alpha.1, Session Manager 1.5.1 and Image Viewer 0.1.2. Newer cores require separate compatibility qualification before delivery.
Dependency cleanup is an explicit action. If safety cannot be established, existing data is retained and the reason is reported.
